    <title>v1.4.2</title>
    <content type="html"><h2>Changes</h2>
<ul>
<li>Bumped <code>sentence-transformers</code> to <code>5.6.0</code>, addressing <a title="CVE-2026-68770" data-hovercard-type="advisory" data-hovercard-url="/advisories/GHSA-jhr6-gm9c-rqjv/hovercard" href="https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jhr6-gm9c-rqjv">CVE-2026-68770</a> (vulnerable range &lt; 5.6.0) (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="6126338414" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/issues/6932" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6932/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6932">#6932</a>)</li>
<li>Bumped <code>pyjwt</code> to <code>2.15.1</code> and mocked <code>PyJWKClient.fetch_data</code> in JWKS auth tests (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5925129828" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/issues/6845" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6845/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6845">#6845</a>, backport of <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5865289547" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/issues/6792" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6792/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6792">#6792</a>)</li>
<li>Bumped <code>urllib3</code> from <code>2.7.0</code> to <code>2.8.0</code> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5940584273" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/issues/6852" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6852/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6852">#6852</a>, backport of <a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5648586399" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/issues/6694" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6694/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6694">#6694</a>)</li>
<li>Updated the UI lockfile to <code>ogx-client ^1.4.1</code> (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5927702741" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/issues/6848" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6848/hovercard" href="https://github.com/ogx-ai/ogx/pull/6848">#6848</a>)</li>
</ul>
